verdict.rationale: Mollie documents test mode as a first-class switch, reachable via a Test API key or a `testmode` parameter. Resources created in test mode are "completely isolated from your live mode data". A test checkout lets you walk through payments without spending money, and a `changePaymentState` URL lets you simulate refunds and chargebacks. Advanced access tokens, the type the MCP server uses, can be scoped to a specific mode, which lets agent workflows be confined to the sandbox. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of test-mode isolation.
